pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When do you say "Gute Nacht"? (1 mark)
   A. When you meet in the morning
   B. When someone goes to bed
   C. When you meet a teacher
   D. When you say hello at midday

2. What does "der Garten" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sofa
   B. garden
   C. house
   D. toilet

3. What does "der Tag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Tuesday
   B. Saturday
   C. Monday
   D. day

4. What does "der Zeh" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. foot
   B. toe
   C. face
   D. hand

5. How is "sch" pronounced in "Schule"? (1 mark)
   A. like s
   B. like ts
   C. like k
   D. like sh

6. How is the letter S named in German? (1 mark)
   A. emm
   B. enn
   C. ess
   D. tset

7. How is "s" pronounced before a vowel, as in "Sonne"? (1 mark)
   A. like z
   B. like ts
   C. like k
   D. like sh

8. Which sentence is a question? (1 mark)
   A. Das ist mein Vater.
   B. Sie ist nett.
   C. Wer ist das?
   D. Er ist groß.

9. What does "die Mutter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. mother
   B. family
   C. brothers and sisters
   D. parents

10. Which month comes right after "September"? (1 mark)
   A. Oktober
   B. Juni
   C. Mai
   D. August

11. What does "Juli" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. January
   B. November
   C. July
   D. September

12. What does "wann" ask about? (1 mark)
   A. Where
   B. How many
   C. Who
   D. When

13. What does "warum" ask? (1 mark)
   A. Where
   B. Who
   C. When
   D. Why

14. Which food is usually called healthy? (1 mark)
   A. Obst
   B. Zucker
   C. Limonade
   D. Chips

15. What does "der Fuß" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. eye
   B. foot
   C. shoulder
   D. arm

16. Which verb form completes "Mutter ___ in der Küche"? (kochen) (1 mark)
   A. koche
   B. kocht
   C. kochst
   D. kochen

17. What does "Was macht sie?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. How old is she?
   B. Where is she?
   C. What is she doing?
   D. Who is she?

18. What is the plural of "die Mutter"? (1 mark)
   A. die Muttere
   B. die Mutteren
   C. die Mutters
   D. die Mütter

19. Which form completes "Ich ___ neun Jahre alt"? (1 mark)
   A. sind
   B. bin
   C. ist
   D. bist

20. Which sentence is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Mein Vater sind groß.
   B. Mein Vater ist groß.
   C. Mein Vater bin groß.
   D. Mein Vater bist groß.

21. Which little word goes with the noun "Tisch"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. den
   D. die

22. Which German word or phrase means "spoon"? (1 mark)
   A. der Löffel
   B. die Lampe
   C. die Toilette
   D. die Gabel

23. Which German word means "to have a shower"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. lernen
   B. hören
   C. duschen
   D. riechen

24. How do you say "on the fifth of May"? (1 mark)
   A. am fünf Mai
   B. am fünften Mai
   C. an fünften Mai
   D. am fünfe Mai

25. What does "Oktober" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. December
   B. June
   C. July
   D. October

26. Which German word means "March"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. Januar
   B. März
   C. November
   D. Februar

27. Which food group does "der Saft" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Fleisch
   B. das Gemüse
   C. die Getränke
   D. das Obst

28. Which German word or phrase means "hair"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kopf
   B. das Haar
   C. das Auge
   D. der Finger

29. What is the plural of "der Zahn"? (1 mark)
   A. die Zähner
   B. die Zahns
   C. die Zähne
   D. die Zahne

30. Which German word or phrase means "ear"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kopf
   B. der Rücken
   C. die Schulter
   D. das Ohr

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the plural of Fuß, Zahn and Auge. (3 marks)

32. Write two sentences about healthy food and one about unhealthy food in German. (3 marks)

33. Write the German words with der, die or das for: finger, brothers and sisters, wind. (3 marks)

34. Write the German names of these months: July, August, September. (3 marks)

35. Unscramble the words: SICHT and TETB. Write them with their articles. (2 marks)

36. Write the German words with der, die or das for: arm, sister. (2 marks)

37. Write the German words with der, die or das for: mother, rainbow, hair. (3 marks)

38. Fill the gaps: "Das Buch ist ___ dem Tisch. Die Katze ist ___ dem Stuhl." Use auf and unter. (2 marks)

39. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bedroom, chair, window, watermelon. (4 marks)

40. Write the German words with der, die or das for: hand, bread, maize. (3 marks)

41. Unscramble and write with der, die or das: NUMD and ESAN. (4 marks)

42. Write three sentences in German about your father or mother: name, age and one adjective. (3 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: party, foot, head, daughter. (4 marks)

44. Explain how a Rückendiktat is done. (3 marks)

45. Write three sentences about the weather in German. (3 marks)

46. Write three sentences about your body in German. (3 marks)

47. Write a sentence about your favourite room in German. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — When someone goes to bed
   Gute Nacht wishes someone a good night as they go to sleep.

2. B — garden
   der Garten means garden.

3. D — day
   der Tag means day.

4. B — toe
   der Zeh means toe.

5. D — like sh
   German sch sounds like the English sh.

6. C — ess
   In German the letter S is called ess.

7. A — like z
   S before a vowel sounds like z.

8. C — Wer ist das?
   Only Wer ist das? asks something.

9. A — mother
   die Mutter means mother.

10. A — Oktober
   After September comes Oktober.

11. C — July
   Juli means July.

12. D — When
   wann means when.

13. D — Why
   warum means why.

14. A — Obst
   Fruit (Obst) is a healthy food.

15. B — foot
   der Fuß means foot.

16. B — kocht
   With Mutter (she) the verb ends in -t.

17. C — What is she doing?
   was macht sie means what does she do.

18. D — die Mütter
   The plural of die Mutter is die Mütter.

19. B — bin
   ich goes with bin.

20. B — Mein Vater ist groß.
   Vater is he, so we use ist.

21. A — der
   It is der Tisch, so the little word is der.

22. A — der Löffel
   spoon in German is der Löffel.

23. C — duschen
   to have a shower in German is duschen.

24. B — am fünften Mai
   am fünften Mai is correct.

25. D — October
   Oktober means October.

26. B — März
   March in German is März.

27. C — die Getränke
   der Saft belongs to die Getränke.

28. B — das Haar
   hair in German is das Haar.

29. C — die Zähne
   The plural of der Zahn is die Zähne.

30. D — das Ohr
   ear in German is das Ohr.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Füße, die Zähne, die Augen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plural.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Obst ist gesund. Wasser ist gesund. Limonade ist ungesund.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Finger, die Geschwister, der Wind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Juli, August, September.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Tisch, das Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with article.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Arm, die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Mutter, der Regenbogen, das Haar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: auf; unter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Schlafzimmer, der Stuhl, das Fenster, die Wassermelone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Hand, das Brot, der Mais.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Mund and die Nase.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for each article.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Meine Mutter heißt Neema. Sie ist 35 Jahre alt. Sie ist nett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Party, der Fuß, der Kopf, die Tochter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: A partner traces letters on your back; you say the letters aloud and write the word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the steps: tracing, saying, writing.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Heute ist es sonnig. Es ist warm. Der Wind weht.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich habe zwei Augen. Das ist meine Nase. Mit den Ohren höre ich.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mein Lieblingszimmer ist die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the sentence and 1 mark for correct spelling.
